mapper.select: SELECT pur.patient_id FROM patient_user_relation pur INNER JOIN patient p ON p.id = pur.patient_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE pur.user_id = #{userId} AND pur.relationship = 'SELF' AND pur.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY pur.created_at ASC, pur.id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hospital WHERE id = #{hospitalId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL )

SELECT tr.department_id, d.name AS department_name, tr.reason, tr.urgency FROM triage_rule tr INNER JOIN department d ON d.id = tr.department_id WHERE tr.hospital_id = #{hospitalId} AND tr.status = 'ENABLED' AND tr.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.hospital_id = #{hospitalId} AND d.status = 'ENABLED' AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
AND #{symptom} ILIKE '%' || tr.keyword || '%' ORDER BY CASE tr.urgency WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END DESC, tr.priority ASC, tr.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO triage_assessment ( patient_id, hospital_id, symptom_input, urgency, recommended_departments ) VALUES ( #{assessment.patientId}, #{assessment.hospitalId}, CAST(#{assessment.symptomInput, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{assessment.urgency}, CAST(#{assessment.recommendedDepartments, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb) )
